name: Alex Jamrozek
title: Senior Software Engineering Department Manager
summary: Engineering leader with 25+ years delivering enterprise software across architecture, hands-on development, and team leadership. Has managed a 6-8 person development team, hired and mentored engineers, led technical teams and consultants, and established delivery practices across complex organizations. Brings a practical record in system modernization, distributed software, CI/CD, automated testing, production readiness, and responsible AI-assisted development.

Software Strategy & Architecture: REST APIs, System Integration & Data Processing
SQL Server, Relational Data Modeling & Data Integration
Engineering Practices & Operations: CI/CD: GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Azure DevOps & Bamboo
Automated Testing, Cucumber, BDD & Unit Testing
AI-Assisted Development: GitHub Copilot, Instruction Files & MCP Integrations

• Used GitHub Copilot with instruction files and MCP integrations while developing test and utility applications
